[![CLA assistant check](https://cla-assistant.io/pull/badge/signed)](https://cla-assistant.io/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor?pullRequest=109)
All committers have signed the CLA.

Thanks for the contribution. I reviewed the PR metadata and ran the relevant local checks.

Validation performed:

```text
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit -p packages/plugin-wordcount/tsconfig.json
pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-core test -- editor
pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-wordcount test
```

These local checks passed in an isolated checkout.

However, this PR cannot be accepted in its current state because of the following blocking issues:

1. CLA is not signed yet:

```text
license/cla: Contributor License Agreement is not signed yet.
```

2. This is a large architecture-level plugin lifecycle/runtime-management change, including new runtime APIs such as `usePlugin`, `unusePlugin`, `reloadPlugin`, command/event buses, dependency ordering, diagnostics, and scoped setup facades. The PR itself marks `OpenSpec change: N/A` and notes that an architecture-level OpenSpec proposal should be added later. For this project, a new capability / architecture-level public API change should be accompanied by an OpenSpec proposal before it can be accepted.

Closing this PR for now. Please sign the CLA and reopen or submit a new PR with the required OpenSpec proposal / architecture design record attached.
